searched: Searched HKEXnews (title search for SenseTime, stock 00020, 2021–2026: the 7 December 2021 Global Offering prospectus, the 2022, 2023 and 2025 annual reports, the 17 December 2023 announcement, the 24 April 2024 SenseNova 5.0 announcement and the 26 June 2025 AGM results announcement), sensetime.com (news pages are a Next.js site whose old news-detail URLs return HTTP 404, including https://www.sensetime.com/cn/news-detail/51167729?categoryId=72 linked from the SenseNova 5.0 filing and https://www.sensetime.com/cn/news-detail/51169523?categoryId=72 from the site’s own sitemap.txt; https://www.sensetime.com/cn/news-index and /en/news-index 404; the current /cn/news listing pages client-side, so the April 2023 SenseNova launch post was not reached; the /cn/ethics page and its linked oss.sensetime.com PDFs were retrieved), the sensenova and SenseTime Hugging Face accounts (model listing; SenseNova-U1-8B-MoT and SenseNova-SI-1.1-InternVL3-8B commit lists; the U1 LICENSE at commit 3b06420 returned HTTP 404), cninfo (announcement search for iFlytek, 002230: annual reports 2012–2025, the 2008 IPO prospectus, Spark launch notices of May 2023, August 2023 and June 2024, the 2025 sustainability report and the January 2026 board resolutions; static.cninfo.com.cn often reset the first connection and the tool retried), iflytek.com (https://www.iflytek.com/cn/ is a JavaScript shell, HTTP 200 with about 3 KB; https://www.iflytek.com/news.html HTTP 404; the English site was not used), and the iflytekopensource/iFlytekSpark-13B Gitee repository (blobless clone for history; raw files at pinned commits, after connection resets). The Hugging Face API returned no iflytek-authored models. Left out: SenseTime’s supplemental prospectus of 20 December 2021 and its cornerstone investors (conditional agreements); round-level amounts and valuations; other principal Pre-IPO Investors (Primavera, Silver Lake, CDH, Sailing, Shanghai International Group, China Structural Reform Fund) and the Taobao China Holding Limited holding (the prospectus passage read does not tie it to Alibaba Group); co-founders Lin Dahua, Ma Kun and Xu Chiheng; SenseTime’s earlier ethics publications (2020 Code of Ethics white paper, 2021–2022 reports) and its 2024 trustworthiness report; SenseNova-SI and other SenseNova open-weight repositories; iFlytek Spark V3.0, V3.5 and X1 release announcements (not located on cninfo; X1 recorded only through the 2025 annual report), the date of the change of iFlytek’s registered name, the 2025–2026 non-public offering, officers other than the chairman and president, and the Spark-13B LICENSE_MODEL.md texts of 30 January and 2 February 2024. No iFlytek-published AI ethics principles or frontier safety framework was located. The SenseTime 2022 annual report was retrieved but not cited (it does not mention SenseNova). Web.archive.org was not tried (refuses connections here). Authorship: no authored records were drafted; the white paper names editors and authors who are not otherwise in the dataset.
